t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Mi talem tru, O God bilong mi, dat Iu nao i wokem mi fo mi save long Iu, an mi prea long Iu. Long disfela taem mi talem tru, dat mi wik too mas an Iu nao i strong too mas, mi pua too mas an Iu i ris too mas. No moa eni other God bat Iu; Iu save help long taem trabol hem kam, an Iu save duim evri samting an stap seleva.
